metadata.title: Container Runtime and Isolation

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for enforcing runtime confinement and isolation of containerized workloads through kernel- and runtime-level controls.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Container runtimes, shared-kernel execution environments, namespaces, cgroups, seccomp, and runtime confinement mechanisms.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Enforces runtime confinement, kernel boundary protection, and isolation guarantees in container platforms.

props.name: depends-on
props.remarks: Runtime isolation builds on baseline container trust and shared-kernel risk assumptions.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Shared-kernel execution risks and container host considerations.

metadata.remarks: Container Runtime and Isolation defines the trust properties required to confine containerized workloads at runtime. This pattern addresses kernel interaction, namespace enforcement, and privilege restriction mechanisms that prevent container escape, privilege escalation, and unintended lateral movement, without covering orchestration policy or supply-chain controls.

components.title: Kernel Boundary Enforcement
components.description: Constrains container workloads to prevent unsafe interaction with the host kernel.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Container escape to host through kernel or runtime exploitation.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Reduction of kernel interfaces and syscalls exposed to container workloads.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Protection of execution integrity for shared kernels.
Least functionality enforced for kernel interfaces exposed to containers.

components.title: Namespace and Resource Isolation
components.description: Separation of process, network, filesystem, and resource namespaces between containers.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Privilege escalation via kernel vulnerabilities accessible through shared namespaces.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Namespace and resource isolation preventing cross-container interference.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Information flow control between containerized processes.

components.title: Runtime Privilege Restriction
components.description: Limits privileges and capabilities available to container workloads at runtime.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Elevation of privileges through excessive runtime capabilities.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Restriction of container runtime privileges and Linux capabilities.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Least privilege enforced for container runtime execution.
Restricted modification of privilege-related runtime configuration.
